pinned: S11-R6: Snapshot retention. Captured snapshots are retained at reducing granularity as they age, measured from the current date: 0–13 months old: every daily capture is kept — full daily per-part detail. This covers the report's longest date preset (366 days / This Year / Last Year) entirely at daily resolution. older than 13 months: reduced to monthly — only the last capture of each calendar month is retained; the other daily captures in this band are pruned.
